data.narrative:
Quobly is a seed-stage quantum computing company founded by Maud Vinet, Tristan Meunier, and François Perruchot. The quantum computing sector comprises 3 public companies (IONQ, RGTI, QBTS) and 8 private firms, including stage-ahead peers Quantinuum, IonQ, PsiQuantum, D-Wave Quantum, and SandboxAQ. Total capital raised remains undisclosed.

The peer-median method is not applicable to this valuation. The quantum computing sector contains insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables meeting minimum cohort density thresholds. While 8 private quantum companies exist in the broader universe, zero same-stage peers, zero adjacent-stage peers, and zero similar-valuation-tier peers were identified—falling short of the required three-datapoint minimum for statistical reliability. A fallback to all-sector median would conflate seed-stage risk and capital requirements with later-stage, better-capitalized competitors and would materially misrepresent valuation fundamentals.

Without sufficient peer triangulation, this analysis cannot produce a defended valuation range. Progression toward a credible range requires either: (1) identification of additional seed-stage quantum or deep-tech comparables with disclosed valuations; (2) application of cost-of-capital or discounted cash flow methods if financial projections exist; or (3) investor transaction data from comparable syndicates. The concentration and maturity disparity within the available peer set precludes meaningful quantitative synthesis at this stage.
